name: beeper-mcp-addon

tools.name: download_attachment
tools.description: Save a message attachment (video, image, audio, document) to a local file and return its path. Identify it with `url` (an mxc:// or localmxc:// URL, or a beeper-mcp://attachments/... URI as returned by the official Beeper MCP), or with `chatID` + `messageID` (+ `index` when a message has several attachments).

chatID.description: Chat ID (or local chat ID) of the message

messageID.description: ID of the message holding the attachment

outputPath.description: Where to save the file. Defaults to a copy in /tmp/beeper-mcp-addon

tools.name: send_file
tools.description: Upload a local file (video, image, audio, document; max 500 MB) and send it to a chat, with an optional caption. This sends a real message on the user's behalf: confirm the recipient first.

chatID.description: Chat ID (or local chat ID) to send to

filePath.description: Absolute path of the file to send

text.description: Optional caption sent with the file

fileName.description: File name shown to the recipient (defaults to the local name)

convert.description: Videos only. auto (default): re-encode with ffmpeg, if installed, when the video would play badly on phones (HEVC, 60 fps, full-range color, rotation metadata…). always / never force it.

tools.name: search_contacts
tools.description: Find people on one account (e.g. WhatsApp, Signal), including people you have never chatted with. A phone number, email or @username is also looked up exactly on the network. Use the returned `id` with start_chat. Account IDs come from the official Beeper MCP's get_accounts.

tools.name: start_chat
tools.description: Open a direct chat with someone, even if you have never messaged them on this account, and return its chatID so you can then send messages or files. Reuses the existing chat when there is one. Identify the person with `userID` (from search_contacts), `phoneNumber`, `username` or `email`. Some networks need a first message to create the chat: pass it in `messageText` (it is sent immediately; confirm with the user first).

accountID.description: Account to start the chat on, e.g. whatsapp.33612345678

fullName.description: Display name, only used to rank candidates

messageText.description: First message, only if the network requires one to create the chat

tools.name: wait_for_message
tools.description: Block until a new message arrives (optionally in one chat and/or from one sender), then return it. Use it to wait for a reply instead of polling. Pass `since` (e.g. the time of your last message) so a reply that arrived just before this call is returned immediately. Returns status "timeout" if nothing came. For waits longer than a few minutes, prefer the background command: /usr/local/bin/node /pkg/node_modules/beeper-mcp-addon/dist/index.js watch --chat <chatID> --once

chatID.description: Only this chat (chat ID or local chat ID). Default: any chat

from.description: Only senders whose name or ID contains this text

since.description: ISO time: also return messages already received after it (needs chatID)

includeOwn.description: Also return messages sent by the user (default false)

tools.name: delete_message
tools.description: Delete (unsend) a message. By default it is deleted for everyone when the network allows it (usually only your own, recent messages). Needs the final message ID: a pendingMessageID from send_file only becomes deletable once the message is sent. This cannot be undone: confirm with the user first.

messageID.description: ID of the message to delete

forEveryone.description: true (default): delete for everyone; false: only for you, when supported

instructions:
Companion to the official Beeper MCP: files (download_attachment, send_file), new chats (search_contacts, start_chat) and delete_message. Tools that send or delete act on the user's behalf: confirm with the user first.

Waiting for a reply or an incoming message:
- If you can run a background command that wakes you on each output line (e.g. Claude Code's Monitor tool), run: /usr/local/bin/node /pkg/node_modules/beeper-mcp-addon/dist/index.js watch --chat <chatID> [--from <name>] --since <ISO time of your last message> --once
  It prints one JSON line when a matching message arrives, then exits. Without --once it keeps watching.
- Otherwise call wait_for_message, which blocks until a message arrives or the timeout is reached.
